verdict.rationale: Eqvista is an equity-management SaaS that holds sensitive company data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI model training, data-use policies, or any opt-out control. The advanced permissions and secure data room features are adjacent access controls and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
